items.title: Charles Schwab Net New Assets Hit $64.8 Billion in August, a Record for the Month
items.summary: Charles Schwab’s  stock was rising Tuesday morning after it reported hauling in $64.8 billion in core net new assets, a record for the month of August.  Analysts watch the company’s asset-gathering figures closely to see how quickly Schwab is growing.  The company said customers opened 424,000 new brokerage accounts in August, an increase of 11% compared with August 2025.
